summary: Implemented the progress file-reading feature (open and wrap_file) in rich/progress.py, with new tests in tests/test_progress.py, docs in docs/source/progress.rst, and a CHANGELOG entry. Changes are additive and uncommitted. Nothing was run: tests, mypy, and black were not executed, so the implementation is verified by reading only. Choices made: io.open is used internally because the module-level open shadows the builtin; the column set is text, bar, DownloadColumn, and TimeRemainingColumn; the context wrapper also stops the display if entering the reader fails. Next step: run the test suite, mypy, and black to confirm.
